summary: All 51 LRE requirements are implemented and traced (15 Java files under lre/). Ten points the requirements do not settle were resolved as recorded below: the '-1 = none' index, the CPA formula and its no-obstacle/zero-velocity cases, invented defaults, transition priorities, the HCM speed, the unspecified CAM manoeuvre, the sign of vvel and the treatment of operator inputs outside OCM.

issues.title: cstc/cdyn are natural numbers but '-1' is required to mean 'no obstacle'
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/Var6: 'natural number variable ... Value -1 means no static/dynamic obstacle exists.' LRE-DM5, LRE-OP3, LRE-OP4: closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex() return -1 if none exists. The profile maps int to nat and forbids negative values.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented 'none' as ObstacleRegister.NO_OBSTACLE = Integer.MAX_VALUE, a natural number the register refuses to store; every sensor function treats it as an absent index (safe large distance, zero fields). No guard compares cstc/cdyn with the sentinel. Confirm this reading or supply a different 'none' encoding.

issues.title: No-dynamic-obstacle defaults conflict between LRE-DM5 and LRE-OP5
issues.raw: LRE-DM5: with no obstacle, nsRelDist/ewRelDist return zero. LRE-OP5: the Sensor returns 'zero-velocity and large-distance defaults' when no dynamic obstacle exists. A CPA computed from zero relative position gives cda = 0, tcpa = 0, which would trigger CAM with no obstacle.
issues.fix_directive: Kept DM5 literally (field accessors return zero) and made cda include the vertical separation vdist(cdyn), which returns the sensor's safe large distance when there is no obstacle; cda is then large and no CAM transition fires.

issues.title: CPA formula: relative velocity, vertical separation, division guard
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 names cda and tcpa but gives no formula. Obstacle velocities are ground-frame (static means zero velocity, LRE-DM2), and no accessor exists for obs_roc.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented horizontal CPA with w = AUV velocity minus obstacle velocity: tcpa = (r.w)/(|w|^2 + cpaEpsilon), cda = sqrt(|r - w*tcpa|^2 + vdist^2), the vertical separation being held constant. cpaEpsilon (invented, 0.000001) keeps the division defined when the relative velocity is zero; the model's constants interface rounds it up to 1, so the model's tcpa/cda differ numerically from Java's.

issues.title: Safe large distance, initial readings and initial advice
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 says distance functions return 'a safe large distance' for no obstacle without a value; no initial sensor readings or initial actuator values are given.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor.SAFE_DISTANCE = 1000.0 m (far above every 1 m threshold). Sensor readings start at 0 until update(); the actuator's advised velocity and heading start at 0 before any advice.

issues.title: Transition priority within each mode
issues.raw: All LRE-Beh requirements have equal priority (8). In Java the first matching branch wins; in the model the profile requires each autonomous guard to conjoin the negations of earlier autonomous guards.
issues.fix_directive: Operator events first in every mode (reqOCM, endTask, reqHCM). Then the autonomous transitions: inOpez -> OCM, then collision risk -> CAM, then the HCM triggers in the order Beh9, Beh11, Beh10. Beh10 ('regardless of velocity') goes last because, with staticObsDfltVertDist = staticObsVertDist, placing it before Beh11 would make Beh11's guard unsatisfiable. The model therefore has extra conjuncts (!inOpez, !collisionRisk, ...) on Beh8-Beh11, Beh13 and Beh14.

issues.title: HCM speed: 0 m/s (LRE-FR3) vs 0.1 m/s (system description)
issues.raw: System description: 'HCM: Reduced speed (0.1 m/s)'. LRE-FR3: 'On entering HCM, the LRE advises a velocity of 0 m/s'.

issues.title: CAM evasive manoeuvre is not specified
issues.raw: LRE-FR4: 'the AUV performs evasive manoeuvres' with no advised velocity or heading given.
issues.fix_directive: Entering CAM emits no output; the last advice stands until CAM is left (Beh17, or Beh18 with advVel(0)). Specify the CAM advice if one is intended.

issues.title: vvel is the signed rate of climb
issues.raw: LRE-OP1: 'vvel is the rate of climb'; LRE-Beh11: 'vvel at or above 1 m/s'. Descending at 1 m/s or more gives vvel <= -1 and does not trigger Beh11.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented literally (vvel = rateOfClimb()). If magnitude was meant, vvel should be |rate_of_climb|.

issues.title: Operations read the closest indices from the sensor; numeric thresholds are named constants
issues.raw: LRE-OP2/OP5 use the indices CalcCStc/CalcCDyn compute, but an operation's compute() may only use sensor calls and its own fields. LRE-Beh4/Beh9/Beh11 state literal thresholds of 1.
issues.fix_directive: CheckOPEZ and CalcCPA call sensor.closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex(), the same functions CalcCStc/CalcCDyn use in the same step, so the values agree. Literal thresholds are separate constants (momEntryMaxVel, momEntryMinDist, highVel, surfaceDepth, minTcpa), not tied to minSafeDist.

issues.title: Operator inputs outside OCM; MOM/HCM guard overlap
issues.raw: LRE-Beh19: outside OCM operator velocity/heading inputs are 'overridden'. LRE-DC1: one transition per Beh requirement. Beh10 (vdist <= staticObsDfltVertDist) and Beh13 (vdist > staticObsVertDist) are disjoint only while staticObsDfltVertDist <= staticObsVertDist.
issues.fix_directive: No transitions were added for reqVel/reqHdng (or reqOCM in OCM) outside the listed ones, so those events are not accepted in those modes. With the given constants (all 1) the MOM/HCM autonomous guards cannot hold at the same time; raising staticObsDfltVertDist above staticObsVertDist would let MOM and HCM alternate without events.
